_note: I034e: PC annotate actor batch grass_valley, files 12-13 of 15: the Up Above actors and the name entry (bank 00) and the trial room Magician with the closing Lisa and Turbo scene (bank 03). Names applied first by renames/apply-I034e_names.json. The hub scene A00S09 has no name string (OQ-I001-6); how the hub is reached, and what the Up Above scenery draws, is not confirmed (OQ-I034-14).

blockNote: The Magician of the Trial Room (area 0 scene 8) and the closing scene with Lisa and Turbo (area 0 scene $0D) (bank 03, the Magician starts at file offset 108460, Lisa's scene at 111418).

gv_npc_magician_01A7AC (meta type $32, switch $00 = the first lair record, placed at tile ($0C,$05) of A00S08). The walkthrough: 'the monster lair nearby will lose its shield, revealing a green switch. Step on it ... a man appears nearby. Go to him and speak with him (B Button) to receive a brief speech and the Soul of Magician.' and 'you also get the Flame Ball Magic'. Talk: 'I used to live up in the sky just like you. Now, I am living on Earth, away from the Master. All the creatures that have been captured by Deathtoll are sealed away in monster lairs. Just as you have set me free, you must free everyone ... Here, take this. <name> received the Flame Ball Magic.' (COP 0A item $11 = Flame Ball), then 'Now I will join you. I am a magician so I can use all types magic ... I need GEMs in order to use magic ... We must go to the Grass Valley Shrine.' It sets souls_flags to 1 (the walkthrough: 'the Soul of Magician') and event flag $0504; the Magician then leaves in a puff of smoke.

gv_npc_lisa_epilogue_01B33A (type $5D, tile ($2C,$29)) runs in two passes of area 0 scene $0D. First pass: the screen shows only text (TM = BG3); the Master speaks to the hero: 'My follower, tell me what is on your mind ... being attracted to a human means that you have not yet established yourself as a heavenly creature. A year has now passed, but your feelings have not changed. Maybe you should try living as a human being ... Once you go down to earth you will lose all memory.' Then COP 10 reloads the same scene (arrival animation 2, x $02F0, y $0290 = tile ($2F,$29)); COP 0D finds the hero on that tile and selects the second pass: Lisa speaks to Turbo ('Hey, Turbo, I feel something strange in the air today. What's wrong with me?'), the hero appears in a puff, '<name>? Is that you? Oh, my! I knew you would come back! What is wrong? Don't you remember me?' with a Yes / No menu (Yes, index 0: 'No, I can't believe this' and then the long text; No: the long text only), 'It's okay ... It's me, Lisa, Daughter of Dr-Leo the inventor! ... We can create many new and wonderful memories together!', 'Okay, let me introduce myself. I am Lisa, and the goat behind me is Turbo', 'Come on Turbo, say hello', 'BLEEEET!', 'He looks like a dog I used to have. That is why I call him Turbo. Come, I will show you around.' and 'Hurry up Turbo!'. Lisa then sets event flag $0000 (Turbo moves, gv_npc_turbo_01B967), the pad is overridden to hold Right ($0100) while the hero walks, and after a wait of $014A frames gv_obj_the_end_text_01B508 prints THE END (gv_epilogue_texts) while Lisa's actor ramps coldata_buffer ($E0 | n, n = 0 ... $1F, one step per 2 frames).
- The village uses the same flag number $0000 for 'set after the crab-walk lesson was spoken' (gv_village_actors_018000); the meaning of the low flags $0000-$0007 is OQ-I034-2.
- The walkthrough chapters do not describe the closing scene; the texts are quoted from the ROM (the extracted strings show an apostrophe as a space, 'can t', and a period as '-').

gv_obj_name_entry_voice_00797B (type $54, placed in A00S01): once (event flag $1F06), 'A voice came from above. "My follower, since you will be able to speak with all living things, you should have a name. Please choose a name for yourself."', the name entry screen (COP 3A) and '<name>,------- What an interesting name. Allright, go and save the world for all creatures.' gv_obj_up_above_map_walker_006E28 (type $53) is the player actor of the hub: it walks a path of seven stops with the pad (walk animations $01-$03, $1E-$2F); on stop k (k = 0 ... 6) B (joy_pressed $8000) plays BRK $98 and starts COP 10 to area 0 scene k+1 (A00S01-A00S07, the shrine scenes of areas-and-scenes.md) at ($70,$50). The stops are linked Down / Right / Up as the path bends: 0 Down to 1, 1 Right to 2, 2 Up to 3, 3 Right to 4, 4 Up to 5, 5 Up to 6, and the opposite pad direction goes back (6 goes back with Right). Every forward step is a gate, opened by the event flag $1B00 ... $1B05 of the same number; gv_obj_up_above_path_markers_007141 draws a pair of marker sprites for every gate flag that is set. gv_obj_up_above_camera_follow_00708E copies the walker's position to the player variables and aims the camera at it. The walker is replaced by the post-ending cut scene gv_obj_up_above_post_ending_007264 when event flag $1F04 is set and $1F05 is clear ($1F04 is set by w6_actor_01EC4B in the World of Evil, $1F05 at the end of that cut scene).

The scenery actors are the meta types $40-$52 (19 entries) and the backdrop type $3D. Types $40, $43 and $46 (gv_obj_up_above_scenery_gated_0070B3) stay while event flag $1F05 is set or neither flag is, and disappear while $1F04 alone is set; types $41, $42, $44, $45, $4A, $4B and $4E have no script of their own (RTL only, $42 draws in front), types $47-$49 and $50-$52 play one fixed animation ($04, $05, $30 and $31, $32, $33), and the three boss markers ($4C, $4D, $4F) play an animation once a lair switch is set: $4C switch $00B6 (animation $18), $4D switch $0009 (the Metal Mantis lair, animation $14), $4F switch $012F (animation $12).
- What the hub shows and when the game sends the player there is not confirmed (OQ-I034-14); the descriptions follow the scripts.
- Event flags: $1F04 / $1F05 post-ending steps, $1F06 the name was chosen, $1B00-$1B05 the six gates of the walker path.

partNotes.gv_obj_up_above_map_walker_006E28:
The walker on the Up Above path (the hub's player actor).

When: meta type $53 in A00S09; runs from the first frame.
Sees: a figure that steps between seven stops with the pad; B on a stop warps to that stop's shrine scene.
Why: it stores its own slot in player_actor (STX), so the engine reads it as the player; its start stop is chosen from its X and Y (X $70 stop 0, $30 stop 1, $1B0 stop 4, $170 stop 5; Y $170 stop 2, $70 stop 3; anything else stop 6).
In: actor script, X = own slot. M = 16 bits.
Out: with flag $1F05 set, or with neither flag, it runs code_006E34: reload_menu_gfx + 1, spawns the markers and the camera follower, joy_block_mask |= $3080, asset caches cleared, then the stop loops; with $1F04 set it branches to gv_obj_up_above_post_ending_007264. Stop k warps with COP 10 (area 0, scene k+1, arrival animation 0, x $70, y $50). Gates: stop 0 Down needs flag $1B00, 1 Right $1B01, 2 Up $1B02, 3 Right $1B03, 4 Up $1B04, 5 Up $1B05 (COP 08 keeps the walker on the stop while the flag is clear).
Clobbers: A.
